commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, re, sys, os
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ref=pathlib.Path(root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); py=[sys.executable, str(root/'executable')]
cases=[
 ['--version'], [], ['--help'], ['-h'],
 ['-i','nope.zip'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--workers','abc'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--workers','0'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--fileNumber','abc'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '--maxPasswordLen','1','--workers','1','-c','l'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','2','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/3.test.txt.zip'), '-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','3','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/4.test.txt.zip'), '-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','4','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-p',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/generated-passwords-lowercase.txt'),'--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/2.test.txt.zip'), '-m','?l?l','--workers','1'],
 ['-i',str(root/'rust-reference/test-files/multi-file-with-dir.zip'), '-c','l','--maxPasswordLen','2','--workers','1'],
]
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'Time elapsed: .*', 'Time elapsed: <time>', s)
fail=0
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
 p=subprocess.run(py+args,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and norm(r.stdout)==norm(p.stdout) and r.stderr==p.stderr)
 print('OK' if ok else 'DIFF', args)
 if not ok:
  fail+=1
  print('ref',r.returncode,repr(norm(r.stdout)),repr(r.stderr))
  print('py ',p.returncode,repr(norm(p.stdout)),repr(p.stderr))
print('failures',fail)
'@ | python -"
